title: Altered Carbon
overview: After 250 years on ice, a prisoner returns to life in a new body with one chance to win his freedom: by solving a mind-bending murder.

title: Always a Witch
overview: A young 17th-century witch time travels to the future to save the man she loves, but first must adjust to present-day Cartagena and defeat a dark rival.

title: As You Stood By
overview: When two women plot to end an abusive marriage through murder, an unexpected visitor arrives — threatening to shatter everything they've carefully planned.

title: Cardinal
overview: Detective John Cardinal attempts to uncover the mystery of what happened to the missing 13-year-old girl whose body is discovered in the shaft-head of an abandoned mine. At the same time, he comes under investigation by his new partner, Lise Delorme, a tough investigator in her own right.

title: Dear Child
overview: A mysterious woman's escape from her harrowing captivity points investigators toward the dark truth behind an unsolved disappearance 13 years earlier.

title: Dept. Q
overview: A brash but brilliant cop becomes head of a new police department, where he leads an unlikely team of misfits in solving Edinburgh's cold cases.

title: Detective Hole
overview: When a series of ritualistic murders hits Oslo, a gifted detective must navigate a puzzle of patterns, corruption and his own demons to catch the killer.

title: Dracula
overview: Transylvania, 1897. The blood-drinking Count Dracula is drawing his plans against Victorian London. And be warned: the dead travel fast.

title: Driven
overview: A resilient girl with a tragic past and a heart of gold falls in love with a bad boy race car driver.

title: Finding Her Edge
overview: A former ice dancer returns to the rink with an exciting new partner while holding onto feelings for her old one — her first love.

title: First Kill
overview: Falling in love is tricky for teens Juliette and Calliope: One's a vampire, the other's a vampire hunter — and both are ready to make their first kill.

title: From Scratch
overview: An artist finds romance with a chef in Italy and embarks on a life-changing journey of love, loss, resilience and hope across cultures and continents.

title: I'm Not Afraid
overview: 10-year-old Miguel stumbles upon a terrifying secret involving a boy trapped in a hole near his home.

title: Last Samurai Standing
overview: In the early Meiji era, Shujiro, once known as an undefeated samurai, decides to participate in a deadly survival game to save his family and villagers.

title: Lead Children
overview: When a young doctor discovers that children living near a smelting plant suffer from lead poisoning, she risks her career and safety to save them.

title: Luis Miguel: The Series
overview: The series dramatizes the life story of Mexican superstar singer Luis Miguel, who has captivated audiences in Latin America and beyond for decades.

title: Missing You
overview: When Detective Kat Donovan matches on a dating app with the fiancé who disappeared years before, she learns that some secrets are best left in the past.

title: My Brilliant Career
overview: Restless, razor-sharp and refusing to conform, 17-year-old Sybylla Melvyn is dead set on writing her own story in an era that expects her to find a man and settle down.

title: My Sad Dead
overview: Emma can see the dead. But when her niece arrives, thousands of lives are shaken.

title: Obsession
overview: A respected London surgeon's affair with his son's fiancée turns into an erotic infatuation that threatens to change their lives forever.

title: Painkiller
overview: The causes and consequences of America's opioid epidemic unfold in this drama following its perpetrators, victims and an investigator seeking the truth.

title: Pantheon
overview: A bullied teen receives mysterious help from someone online: a stranger soon revealed to be her recently deceased father, David, whose consciousness has been uploaded to the Cloud following an experimental destructive brain scan. David is the first of a new kind of being – an “Uploaded Intelligence” or “UI” – but he will not be the last, as a global conspiracy unfolds that threatens to trigger a new kind of world war.

title: PIECES OF HER
overview: A woman pieces together her mother's dark past after a violent attack in their small town brings hidden threats and deadly secrets to light.

title: Shadow and Bone
overview: In a world cleaved in two by a massive barrier of perpetual darkness, a young soldier uncovers a power that might finally unite her country. But as she struggles to hone her power, dangerous forces plot against her. Thugs, thieves, assassins and saints are at war now, and it will take more than magic to survive.

title: Stay Close
overview: When Carlton Flynn vanishes 17 years to the night after Stewart Green did, it sets off a chain reaction in the lives of people connected to both men.

title: The Baby-Sitters Club
overview: In this contemporary take on the beloved book series, five best friends launch a baby-sitting business that's big on fun and adventure.

title: The Doll
overview: When Stanisław falls in love with the aristocratic Izabela, he dedicates his entire life to winning her over.

title: The Gift
overview: A painter in Istanbul embarks on a personal journey as she unearths universal secrets about an Anatolian archaeological site and its link to her past.

title: The Innocent
overview: An accidental killing leads a man down a dark hole of intrigue and murder. Just as he finds love and freedom, one phone call brings back the nightmare.

title: The Map of Longing
overview: Before her death, Lucy creates a game for her sister, Greta, pushing her into a journey of self-discovery — and toward the charming Will Tucker.

title: The Midnight Club
overview: Inside a hospice for terminally ill teens, members of an exclusive club make a chilling pact: The first to die must send a sign from beyond the grave.

title: Museum of Innocence
overview: In 1970s Istanbul, a man's forbidden love for a shop-girl evolves into a lifelong journey of obsession and longing.

title: The Perfect Couple
overview: Amelia is about to marry into one of the wealthiest families on Nantucket, until a shocking death derails the wedding — and turns everyone into a suspect.

title: The Scandal
overview: In Joseon, a secret proposal ignites hidden desires in a gifted noblewoman, a famed lover and an unsuspecting lady caught in their dangerous game.

title: The Snitch Cartel: Origins
overview: Over four decades, two brothers in Cali juggle family duties, multiple romances and illicit businesses, transforming from poor kids to cocaine kingpins.

title: The Spy
overview: In the 1960s, Israeli clerk-turned-secret agent Eli Cohen goes deep undercover inside Syria on a perilous, years-long mission to spy for Mossad.

title: The Stranger
overview: When a stranger makes a shocking claim about his wife, Adam Price's life upends as he becomes entangled in a web of secrets.

title: Troy: Fall of a City
overview: Told from the perspective of the Trojan Family, the rich history of the Trojan War is explored, as well as the love, intrigue and betrayal of those who lived through it. On a trip to Sparta as a guest of Menelaus, Paris, son of Troy, falls in love with Menelaus' wife, Helen. After they depart Sparta together for Troy, Helen and Paris risk not only their lives, but those of their families and people as they trigger a chain of events that ultimately lead them all into an unending war.

title: You Don't Know Me
overview: Accused of murder, Hero shouldn't stand a chance in court. He swears he's innocent. But in the end, all that matters is this: do you believe him?
